content.control_anchor_policy: same immutable control organism retained in every generation; offspring may be mutated but anchor genome never changes
content.elite_policy: preserve frozen control anchor plus nine highest-fitness non-control genomes
content.final_freeze: top ten Generation-10 genomes by frozen fitness ranking
content.parent_pool: ten active elites; deterministic seeded selection with replacement
content.retirement: all non-survivors become permanent graveyard and may never reproduce
content.uniqueness: all 50 membership genome_ids must be unique
